name: ss
description: Ship Shape (ss): technical skills for building software, invoked as /ss:<skill>. /ss:go routes a request to a playbook (investigate, bug-fix, review, ui-critique, iterate, ship, babysit, review-setup, learn) and sizes it to risk with a lightweight, standard or intensive route; on the standard and intensive routes it opens with /ss:clarify and ends with the goal loop (references/goal-loop.md), a fresh judge each round until every goal is achieved and the judge is pleased. The flow is clarify → build → ship (/ss:clarify maps the problem, edges included, and settles verifiable goals approved once, the build is the work itself under the goal loop, /ss:ship lands the branch). Alongside: /ss:bug-fix (a bug to a proven fix), /ss:investigate (a question about this repo and your sessions) and /ss:research (what lies outside it, every claim verified), /ss:review (its judge is the ss-review-judge agent on Sonnet, checking the change's goals with no default round limit; its edges front hunts the inputs a diff does not handle), /ss:iterate (improves what already exists until a measured bar is met, such as parity with an old API, a benchmark, a pass rate, a bot's behavior or a rubric, with the judge picked for the target: the door to the goal loop), /ss:ui-critique (iterate's door for a screen: a screen judged on real screenshots by the ss-design-critic agent with an accessibility check each round by the ss-a11y-auditor agent, and fixed until the critic is pleased), /ss:babysit (a watcher on one PR), /ss:caretake (the PRs that are not yours: the repo digest, or adopting or modernizing one PR), /ss:learn (a lesson kept as a check, a review rule through /ss:review-setup, or a project fact in the repo's CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md; /ss:go offers it when the same correction lands twice), /ss:orchestrate (one front per Desktop session, its memory a private Claude Docs doc or a local folder under ~/.ss/fronts), and situational skills an agent loads when their trigger in references/triggers.md fires. Any ss session merges a PR when the person says so in its chat, under the repository's rules.
